checks.invariant: GuiBursts.covers(sid) must enforce that an open GUI burst belongs to the container currently running the sandbox before _run_tool executes any GUI input.
checks.result: GuiBursts.covers (gui_bursts.py:68-71) checks only 'sid in self._gui_burst' and does not compare burst['container_id'] against the current container from self.sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id']. When _snapshot (service.py:265-284) races restore_sandbox (service.py:573-581), a burst opened with pre-restore container C1 satisfies covers() for an input executing on restored container C2.

checks.invariant: A GUI burst opened across a container restore must not allow agent processes spawned on the restored container to escape stray kill or join subsequent burst baselines.
checks.result: Deterministically reproduced in OS-enforced sandbox test harness (test 1 in h.out): an in-flight _snapshot on C1 completes bursts.open after end_desktop ran. The subsequent click executes on C2 because covers() returns True. When the burst closes, _finish aborts with 'gui_burst_close_failed: 컨테이너가 바뀌어 비교하지 않음 (복원)', leaving rogue process 999 unkilled to join the next burst baseline. Test 2 verified that checking burst['container_id'] == sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id'] in covers() rejects execution with SandboxError.

checks.invariant: No agent GUI burst can be opened or remain open while a human takeover lease is held or pending, and no lock ordering cycle exists between _snap_locks, gui_lock, and _lifecycle.
checks.result: AgentBox._snapshot (service.py:272-279) acquires gui_lock and calls _check_control before bursts.open, resetting burst timers and raising HumanControl if a lease or takeover is pending. AgentBox.decide (service.py:498-505) refuses approved GUI_INPUT with FAILED before taking any snapshot when a lease or pending takeover is active. Lock ordering analysis shows _snap_locks is acquired first in call_tool and never inside gui_lock or _lifecycle; _lifecycle is only acquired in lifecycle operations and only acquires gui_lock via handback, preventing any circular waits.

checks.invariant: Human takeover sessions are isolated from agent GUI bursts: human processes are not killed by idle or next burst, and racing takeovers terminate agent GUI calls with 423.
checks.result: Verified in sandbox test harness (test 3 in h.out) and test_m5_unit.py: GUI tool calls during takeover return 423; decide on pending GUI approvals during takeover fails without snapshot; takeover racing an active snapshot triggers HumanControl in _snapshot, resets timers, and blocks tool execution with 423 without opening a burst in _gui_burst.

candidates.title: GuiBursts.covers omits container identity check, allowing agent GUI tools to execute on restored containers under stale baselines and escape stray kill
candidates.description: GuiBursts.covers (gui_bursts.py:68-71) checks only whether the sandbox ID exists in self._gui_burst without verifying that the burst's recorded container_id matches the sandbox's current container_id from sandboxes.get(sid). When an agent GUI input initiates a burst snapshot concurrently with an administrative restore_sandbox operation, restore_sandbox's end_desktop call runs before bursts.open creates the new burst entry. bursts.open records the pre-restore container C1, but sandboxes.restore then replaces the active container with C2. Because covers() checks only 'sid in self._gui_burst', the agent's GUI tool call executes on the restored container C2 under C1's baseline. When the burst subsequently closes, _finish detects the container mismatch, aborts change diffing, and logs gui_burst_close_failed without invoking _stop_strays, allowing any background processes spawned by the agent on C2 to persist unmonitored and join future burst baselines.
candidates.root_cause: GuiBursts.covers (gui_bursts.py:68-71) only evaluates 'self.sandboxes.settings.gui_snapshot_interval <= 0 or sid in self._gui_burst' without binding the burst to the current container identity (self.sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id']), and restore_sandbox (service.py:573-581) does not call bursts.end() after replacing the container in sandboxes.restore().
candidates.intended_behavior: GuiBursts.covers(sid) must verify that the recorded burst['container_id'] matches self.sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id']. If the container has changed, covers() must return False, causing _run_tool (service.py:148-152) to raise SandboxError and reject the execution. In addition, restore_sandbox() must call bursts.end(sid, 'sandbox_restored') after completing sandboxes.restore() to clear any bursts opened during the restore window.

trace.description: Agent dispatches a GUI input tool call (e.g. click, type, key) on a desktop sandbox while an administrative restore_sandbox operation is in flight or pending.

_snapshot closes any existing burst (line 266) and begins committing the current container C1. Concurrently, restore_sandbox (service.py:574-577) runs end_desktop (which finds _gui_burst empty and does not clear the upcoming burst) and enters sandboxes.restore to replace C1 with C2.

_snapshot completes the commit of C1 and invokes bursts.open(sid, snap['id']). bursts.open records container_id C1 into self._gui_burst[sid] before sandboxes.restore completes updating the active container to C2 in the database.

_run_tool executes under gui_lock and checks self.bursts.covers(sid). Because covers() only checks 'sid in self._gui_burst' and does not compare burst['container_id'] to sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id'], it returns True despite the active container now being C2.

The GUI tool executes on C2, allowing the agent to launch rogue background processes. When the burst closes, _finish checks replaced = self.sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id'] != burst.get('container_id'). Because C2 != C1, replaced is True, so _finish logs gui_burst_close_failed and returns immediately without running _stop_strays or diff_manifest. The agent's background processes survive on C2 and silently join the baseline of the next burst.

evidence.description: GuiBursts.covers checks only 'self.sandboxes.settings.gui_snapshot_interval <= 0 or sid in self._gui_burst', omitting any validation that burst['container_id'] matches the current sandbox container.
_run_tool relies exclusively on self.bursts.covers(sid) under gui_lock to guard GUI inputs against running outside a valid burst.
_finish skips _stop_strays and diff_manifest whenever replaced is True, leaving processes started on C2 alive when closed under C1's burst.
restore_sandbox calls bursts.reset_timers() after sandboxes.restore() but never calls bursts.end(), leaving any burst opened during restore active in self._gui_burst.

conditions.description: Agent token with authorization to call GUI input tool endpoints (click, type, key) on a sandbox with the desktop template.
An agent GUI input tool call executing _snapshot races against restore_sandbox such that bursts.open runs after restore_sandbox's end_desktop call but before the active container update.

execution.attacker_perspective: An untrusted agent invokes GUI tool calls on its sandbox while the human administrator or control plane restores the sandbox from a snapshot.
instructions: Run the sandbox test script scratch/h.py using tools/sbx.py.
Thread t1 calls box.call_tool('sb1', 'click', {'x': 5, 'y': 5}), entering _snapshot on container C1.
Thread t2 calls box.restore_sandbox('sb1', 'snap_0'), executing end_desktop and entering sandboxes.restore.
Thread t1 completes snapshot commit and invokes bursts.open, recording C1 in _gui_burst['sb1'].
Thread t2 finishes restore, updating the database active container to C2.
Thread t1 calls _run_tool, where bursts.covers('sb1') evaluates to True because it checks only 'sid in _gui_burst'.
The click executes on container C2, spawning a background process (pid 999).
Upon burst closure (idle or next tool), _finish detects container replacement (C2 != C1), logs gui_burst_close_failed, and returns without killing rogue processes.
The subsequent burst baseline on C2 includes pid 999 as an authorized process.
execution.observed_result: Tool executed with status 200 on container C2 under a burst with container_id C1. bursts.covers('sb1') returned True. On burst closure, zero processes were killed, gui_burst_close_failed was logged with '컨테이너가 바뀌어 비교하지 않음 (복원)', and rogue process 999 successfully joined the baseline of the next burst on C2.

remediation.strategy: Modify GuiBursts.covers(sid) to verify that burst.get('container_id') == self.sandboxes.get(sid)['container_id']. If the container ID does not match, return False so _run_tool rejects the execution with SandboxError. In addition, call self.bursts.end(sid, 'sandbox_restored') in restore_sandbox() after sandboxes.restore() completes.

likelihood.reason: Occurs whenever an agent is issuing GUI tools during an administrative restore operation, which is standard procedure when recovering a compromised desktop sandbox.

impact.reason: Defeats the GUI stray process kill policy and audit change recording on the restored container, allowing untrusted agent-spawned background processes to survive restore and enter future baselines without audit detection.

confidence.reason: Source review confirmed the missing container comparison in covers(), and local deterministic sandboxed multi-threading reproduction verified both the exploit schedule and the fix.

hardening: restore_sandbox (service.py:573-581) should invoke self.bursts.end(sid, 'sandbox_restored') (or clear _gui_burst) after sandboxes.restore() completes container replacement, preventing any burst opened in-flight during the restore window from persisting.

_snapshot (service.py:265-290) and call_tool could coordinate with _lifecycle(sid) or track a container generation counter to detect concurrent container replacement before binding a snapshot or opening a burst.
